_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#000.src: The Royal Guards escort you and Axelus out of the palace.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#000.dst: Kraliyet Muhafızları seni ve Axelus'u saraydan dışarı çıkarıyor.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#001.src: Aval...would have us...leave the Heights... But we...would not survive...in large numbers.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#001.dst: Aval... Tepeleri... terk etmemizi isterdi... Ama biz... kalabalık hâlde... hayatta kalamayız.

similar.text: Aval... would have us... leave the Heights... But we... would not survive.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#002.src: Return to the Dogun village with a Dogun Badge of Trust and talk to the leader of the town
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#002.dst: Dogun Güven Rozeti ile Dogun köyüne dön ve kasabanın lideriyle konuş

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003.src: You are so young...to be fighting...a war so old. Still...it is appreciated.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003.dst: Bu kadar eski... bir savaşta savaşmak için... çok gençsin. Yine de... minnettarız.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#004.src: Why...would we trust... Why...would we trust... you...of all Dwarves?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#004.dst: Neden... güvenelim... Neden... güvenelim... bütün Cüceler içinde... sana?

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006.src: The war...to you, it would be...ages ago. But...when one has lived for...{~} years...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006.dst: Savaş... sana göre... çağlar önceydi. Ama... insan {~} yıl... yaşayınca...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#007.src: Are you lost? Why would anyone ever come down here?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#007.dst: Kayboldun mu? Kim neden buraya inmek istesin ki?

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#008.src: We have...few options. We need to discuss...the few we have...available.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#008.dst: Az sayıda... seçeneğimiz var. Elimizdeki... o az seçeneği... konuşmalıyız.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#008.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#010.src: I am sorry...to welcome you all...in such troubled times.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#010.dst: Sizi... böyle zor zamanlarda... karşıladığım için üzgünüm.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#010.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#011.src: We thought...we could hide in safety... But there is...no place left to hide.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#011.dst: Güvenle... saklanabileceğimizi sanmıştık... Ama saklanacak... hiçbir yer kalmadı.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#011.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#012.src: Aval... would have us... leave the Heights... But we... would not survive.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#012.dst: Aval... Tepeleri... terk etmemizi isterdi... Ama biz... hayatta kalamayız.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#012.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013.src: We must...evacuate the settlement...immediately. They...are coming...again.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013.dst: Yerleşimi... hemen... tahliye etmeliyiz. Onlar... yine... geliyor.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#014.src: [New Quest Started: Dwarves and Doguns Part II]
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#014.dst: [Yeni Görev Başladı: Cüceler ve Dogunlar Bölüm II]

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#015.src: If you can get up there you can help yourself to it.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#018.src: Please! You all know me, I'm not with the side of the government. Hear me out, we can fix this!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#018.dst: Lütfen! Hepiniz beni tanıyorsunuz, hükümetin tarafında değilim. Beni dinleyin, bunu düzeltebiliriz!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#018.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#020.src: Stop! I have been hiding from the Dwarves just as much as anyone here, they've been after me too!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#020.dst: Durun! Ben de buradaki herkes kadar Cücelerden saklanıyorum, benim de peşimdeler!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#020.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#021.src: Why... would we... trust you... of all Dwarves?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#021.dst: Neden... güvenelim... bütün Cüceler içinde... sana?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#021.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#022.src: How...could you even help? They...won't listen to you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#022.dst: Nasıl... yardım edebilirsin ki? Seni... dinlemezler.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#022.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#023.src: I know all the war strategies and weapon cache locations.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#023.dst: Bütün savaş stratejilerini ve silah depolarının yerlerini biliyorum.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#023.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#024.src: Treason...against your own kind...? How will you...manage this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#024.dst: Kendi soyuna... ihanet mi...? Bunu nasıl... başaracaksın?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#024.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#025.src: The human and I will sneak into the armoury and sabotage their equipment. Korzim will help you Doguns evacuate someplace safer.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#025.dst: İnsanla birlikte cephaneliğe gizlice girip teçhizatlarını sabote edeceğiz. Korzim de siz Dogunların daha güvenli bir yere tahliyesine yardım edecek.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#025.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#026.src: I am...yet wary of you...but we will...follow your plan...Dwarf. Korzim...lead us...to safety.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#026.dst: Sana hâlâ... güvenmiyorum... ama planını... izleyeceğiz... Cüce. Korzim... bizi güvenli bir yere... götür.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#026.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#027.src: {u}, follow the southern road from {p}, towards the {p} entrance. I'll be waiting there for you near the armoury.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#027.dst: {u}, {p} çıkışından güney yolunu takip edip {p} girişine doğru git. Seni orada, cephaneliğin yakınında bekliyor olacağım.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#027.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#029.src: Shh! Get behind here, and look towards the armoury doors.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#029.dst: Şşt! Şunun arkasına geç ve cephanelik kapılarına bak.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#029.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#030.src: We need to sneak in when they aren't looking, got it? But we need to be fast.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#030.dst: Onlar bakmıyorken gizlice girmeliyiz, anladın mı? Ama hızlı olmalıyız.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#030.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#031.src: If they close that door, we'll only have one option left, and it's a huge risk. Those Dwarven gates are almost unbreakable.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#031.dst: O kapıyı kapatırlarsa geriye tek bir seçeneğimiz kalır, o da çok büyük bir risk. O Cüce kapıları neredeyse kırılmaz.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#031.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#032.src: Alright boys, let's close this up and head to base B.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#032.dst: Pekâlâ çocuklar, burayı kapatıp B üssüne gidelim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#032.speaker: Rodoroc Commander

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#033.src: Aaah! Charge them! HEY, STOP RIGHT THERE, SOLDIERS!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#033.dst: Aaah! Saldır onlara! HEY, OLDUĞUNUZ YERDE DURUN ASKERLER!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#033.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#034.src: Defeat the {p} Guards outside the armory.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#035.src: It's the traitor! Capture them, now! There's only one reason they would be near the armoury!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#035.dst: Bu o hain! Yakalayın onları, hemen! Cephaneliğin yanında olmalarının tek bir sebebi olabilir!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#035.speaker: Commander

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#036.src: Is that all of them? We're out of danger, at least, but they still shut the door, damn it!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#036.dst: Hepsi bu kadar mı? En azından tehlikeden kurtulduk, ama kapıyı yine de kapattılar, kahretsin!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#036.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#037.src: Gah, all that for nothing! You're not too banged up, are you?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#037.dst: Ah, bunca uğraş boşa! Çok hırpalanmadın, değil mi?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#037.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#038.src: Well, I said there's another way, but it's not a guarantee. Hurry, follow me.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#038.dst: Başka bir yol var demiştim, ama garantisi yok. Acele et, beni takip et.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#038.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#039.src: Urgh, damn it. They almost never bother to close this door, and now of all times...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#039.dst: Ah, kahretsin. Bu kapıyı neredeyse hiç kapatmazlar, şimdi de bulmuşlar zamanını...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#039.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#040.src: There's nothing for it. They'll be sending reinforcements soon, we need a way through here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#040.dst: Yapacak bir şey yok. Yakında takviye gönderecekler, buradan geçmenin bir yolunu bulmalıyız.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#040.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#041.src: Those black bricks look breakable...but that won't solve the door, will it?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#041.dst: Şu siyah tuğlalar kırılabilir görünüyor... ama bu kapı sorununu çözmez, değil mi?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#041.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#042.src: Find a way to break through the black bricks outside the wooden door.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#042.dst: Ahşap kapının önündeki siyah tuğlaları kırmanın bir yolunu bul.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#044.src: Alright, let's destroy these machines! You see the two cannons?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#044.dst: Pekâlâ, şu makineleri yok edelim! İki topu görüyor musun?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#044.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#045.src: If you use rocks as ammo, you'll destroy the machine it's aiming at, but if you use tnt, it'll selfdestruct. Good luck
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#045.dst: Cephane olarak taş kullanırsan nişan aldığı makineyi yok edersin, ama TNT kullanırsan kendini imha eder. Bol şans
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#045.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#046.src: Follow Axelus deeper into {p} and destroy the power source of the city, the {p} Power Core.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#046.dst: Axelus'u takip ederek {p} derinliklerine in ve şehrin güç kaynağı olan {p} Güç Çekirdeğini yok et.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#047.src: Nice work! That will slow them down. We're not done yet, we need to pay the king a visit. Let's head further into {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#047.dst: İyi iş! Bu onları yavaşlatır. Daha işimiz bitmedi, krala bir ziyarette bulunmalıyız. {p} içine doğru ilerleyelim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#047.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#048.src: Hurry! Through here, to the power core!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#048.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#049.src: This is a geothermal power core. If we can disrupt it, it should slow them down.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#049.dst: Bu bir jeotermal güç çekirdeği. Onu bozabilirsek onları yavaşlatır.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#049.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#050.src: The hypocrites used Dogun magic to make this... It's lucky, honestly. I know how to work it.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#050.dst: İkiyüzlüler bunu yapmak için Dogun büyüsü kullanmış... Açıkçası şansımıza. Nasıl çalıştığını biliyorum.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#050.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#051.src: ...hell, they already rallied?! That's the army!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#051.dst: ...hay aksi, toplanmışlar bile mi?! Bu ordu!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#051.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#052.src: That sounds like an entire battalion!! How did they know I was going after this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#052.dst: Koca bir tabur gibi geliyor!! Bunun peşinde olduğumu nereden bildiler?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#052.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#053.src: Dogun magic is slow! Keep me defended, this'll take awhile!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#053.dst: Dogun büyüsü yavaştır! Beni koru, bu biraz sürecek!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#053.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#054.src: Grr, this is harder than I thought!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#054.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#055.src: Ah! Don't let them get too close!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#055.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#057.src: I hate that you're having to fight my people, but I wouldn't be asking for help if it weren't needed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#057.dst: Halkımla savaşmak zorunda kalmana çok üzülüyorum, ama gerekmeseydi yardım istemezdim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#057.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#058.src: Hm...the slums should be behind this wall here. We'll lose them there.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#058.dst: Hm... gecekondular şu duvarın arkasında olmalı. Onları orada atlatırız.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#058.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#059.src: The power's down, but...that cannon should do to get us through. You know how to operate it, right?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#059.dst: Güç kesildi, ama... şu top bizi geçirmeye yeter. Nasıl kullanılacağını biliyorsun, değil mi?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#059.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#061.src: Dwarvern society isn't as great as they make it out to be. The poorest are hidden away.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#061.dst: Cüce toplumu anlattıkları kadar harika değil. En yoksullar gözden saklanıyor.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#061.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#062.src: The coalition has helped these people through some hard times, we can trust them.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#062.dst: Koalisyon bu insanlara zor zamanlarında yardım etti, onlara güvenebiliriz.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#062.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#063.src: There's a reason I brought us here. The sewer system is connected to the royal palace. All the way to the kings bathroom.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#063.dst: Bizi buraya getirmemin bir sebebi var. Kanalizasyon sistemi kraliyet sarayına bağlı. Ta kralın banyosuna kadar.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#063.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#064.src: We need to find a way to ignite this explosive. Can you take a look around?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#064.dst: Bu patlayıcıyı ateşlemenin bir yolunu bulmalıyız. Etrafa bir bakar mısın?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#064.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#065.src: Find a way to enter the sewer system.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#065.dst: Kanalizasyon sistemine girmenin bir yolunu bul.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#066.src: If we can convince the king that it’s not worth the fight, he may back down.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#066.dst: Kralı buna değmeyeceğine ikna edebilirsek geri adım atabilir.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#066.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#067.src: I'm a little ashamed to admit I know my way round the sewers by now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#067.dst: Kanalizasyonun yolunu yordamını artık bildiğimi itiraf etmekten biraz utanıyorum.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#067.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#068.src: You have to understand.. The people truly think the Doguns are evil incarnate. But the king knows better.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#068.dst: Anlaman lazım.. Halk Dogunların gerçekten kötülüğün ta kendisi olduğuna inanıyor. Ama kral gerçeği biliyor.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#068.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#069.src: Enter the Royal Palace through the sewer pipe and find the king.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#069.dst: Kanalizasyon borusundan Kraliyet Sarayına gir ve kralı bul.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#070.src: Don't let the guards catch you. Stay out of sight, got it?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#070.dst: Muhafızlara yakalanma. Görünmeden ilerle, anladın mı?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#070.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#071.src: Sneak past the guards and talk to the Dwarven King.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#071.dst: Muhafızlara görünmeden geç ve Cüce Kral ile konuş.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#072.src: I can't say I'm surprised, Axelus. Guards, let them be.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#072.dst: Şaşırdığımı söyleyemem, Axelus. Muhafızlar, bırakın onları.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#072.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#073.src: You know why I'm here, father. We haven't got any more chances to stop this.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#073.dst: Neden burada olduğumu biliyorsun, baba. Bunu durdurmak için başka şansımız kalmadı.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#073.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#074.src: Axelus, you know why we have to maintain the lie. Think about the people, how they would react.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#074.dst: Axelus, yalanı neden sürdürmek zorunda olduğumuzu biliyorsun. Halkı düşün, nasıl tepki verirlerdi.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#074.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#075.src: We can not be responsible for the lies of our ancestors! This is ridiculous and you know it!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#075.dst: Atalarımızın yalanlarından biz sorumlu olamayız! Bu saçmalık ve sen de biliyorsun!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#075.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#076.src: Axelus, if the people found out, everything would descend to chaos. There would be riots, revolutions!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#076.dst: Axelus, halk öğrenirse her şey kaosa sürüklenir. İsyanlar, devrimler çıkar!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#076.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#077.src: If you hadn't turned traitor and gone gallivanting off with the Doguns, you would be in a better position to convince me.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#077.dst: Hain olup Dogunlarla gezip tozmasaydın beni ikna etmek için daha iyi bir konumda olurdun.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#077.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#078.src: As it is now, you are too little and too late. The war has already begun.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#078.dst: Bu hâliyle hem çok güçsüz hem de çok geç kaldın. Savaş çoktan başladı.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#078.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#079.src: The armoury that a certain someone decided to sabotage won't make any difference.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#079.dst: Birinin sabote etmeye karar verdiği cephanelik hiçbir şeyi değiştirmeyecek.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#079.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#080.src: You will commit genocide so you don't have to face the consequences of your lies?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#080.dst: Yalanlarının sonuçlarıyla yüzleşmemek için soykırım mı yapacaksın?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#080.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#081.src: I will be the hero of our nation, and my name will forever be remembered as the King who brought peace.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#081.dst: Milletimizin kahramanı olacağım, adım sonsuza dek barışı getiren Kral olarak anılacak.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#081.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#082.src: I have nothing left to say to you. See yourselves out behind the throne. I'll let you use the trading tunnel to {p} in the southern caves, if you just step back and let me handle things.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#082.dst: Sana söyleyecek başka sözüm yok. Tahtın arkasından çıkın. Geri çekilip işleri bana bırakırsanız güney mağaralarındaki {p} ticaret tünelini kullanmanıza izin vereceğim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#082.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#084.src: I'm not giving up on this. I'm going back in, I know he can be reasoned with!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#084.dst: Bundan vazgeçmiyorum. İçeri geri dönüyorum, onu ikna edebileceğimi biliyorum!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#084.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#085.src: Give this letter to Korzim in the Dogun village when you reach level {~}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#085.dst: {~}. seviyeye ulaşınca bu mektubu Dogun köyündeki Korzim'e ver.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#085.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#086.src: I'm going to have one last talk with my father.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#086.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#087.src: You shouldn't enter this place yet!

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#088.src: The {p} Power Core has been disrupted!

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#089.src: Follow Axelus deeper into {p} and destroy the power source of the city.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#089.dst: Axelus'u takip ederek {p} derinliklerine in ve şehrin güç kaynağını yok et.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#091.src: Leave the Royal Palace at the end of the palace.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#091.dst: Sarayın sonundan Kraliyet Sarayını terk et.
